title: World Blue: How to Avoid Monthly Fees
summary: This document explains how to avoid the World Blue monthly maintenance fee of $50.00 by maintaining an eligible balance at or above $25,000, while always keeping total balance at or above $10,000. It also covers tactics to stay above $25,000, avoiding overdrafts ($30.00 fee), and how to verify statement-period status and contact support via the dashboard if charged in error.
